response.text:
I can help — but removing calendar items is destructive, so I need a few confirmations to avoid mistakes.

Please confirm (or answer) each item below:

1) Date range: by “next week” do you mean Monday July 13 — Sunday July 19, 2026? If not, give the exact date range or your preferred week start day/time zone.

2) Which events: do you mean
   - only meetings (events that include other attendees), or
   - every event (including personal/all‑day items)?

3) Ownership: should this include
   - events you organize (where you are the organizer),
   - events you were invited to (where you are an attendee),
   - or both?

4) Action to take (pick one)
   - Delete from your calendar only (no notifications to others),
   - Cancel and send cancellation emails to attendees (only possible if you are the organizer),
   - Decline/leave the meetings (maintains event for others; removes you as attendee).

5) Recurring events: if a meeting is part of a recurring series, do you want to remove only the occurrences during next week or cancel the entire series?

6) Which calendar (if you have multiple): e.g., "Work", "Personal", or all calendars.

Reply with your choices (you can copy numbers, e.g. “Yes — Jul13–19; only meetings; both organizers & attendee invites; Cancel & send cancellations; only next‑week occurrences; Work calendar”). I will not make changes until you confirm these details.
